plain_english: I bow to you — death's ender, love's crusher, Gaṅgā crowned on the pate, worker of meet right.
sanskrit_cite: namaḥ kṛtakṛtāntānta tubhyaṃ madanamardine mastakanyastagaṅgāya yathāyuktārthakāriṇe

plain_english: High past sway and gnosis, past dispassion and writs stands what men pray for — cut off from you, lord, what loftier haven for the praying?
sanskrit_cite: aiśvaryajñānavairāgyadharmebhyo 'py upari sthitim nātha prārthayamānānāṃ tvad ṛte kā parā gatiḥ

plain_english: Should you not wish it, Śambhu, who could crook a straw? Graced by your wish — who would shirk Brahmā's burden?
sanskrit_cite: tvayy anicchati kaḥ śambho śaktaḥ kubjayituṃ tṛṇam tvadicchānugṛhītas tu vahed brāhmīṃ dhuraṃ na kaḥ

plain_english: The brain-rich, crests high with gemmy wreaths from bending to Hara — to what Highest would they kneel, whom would they not incline?
sanskrit_cite: harapraṇatimāṇikyamukuṭotkaṭamastakāḥ nameyuḥ kaṃ paraṃ kaṃ vā namayeyur na dhīdhanāḥ

plain_english: Quiverless, quit of every stray, a mere of sweet — O let me settle in mid-sea of your knowing, Matted One.
sanskrit_cite: sarvavibhramanirmokaniṣkampam amṛtahradam bhavajjñānāmbudher madhyam adhyāsīyāpi dhūrjaṭe

plain_english: A marvel — eyed askance though it be, strayed into fancy though it be — the last fruit, lord, you grant entire.
sanskrit_cite: citraṃ yac citradṛṣṭo 'pi manorathagato 'pi vā paramārthaphalaṃ nātha paripūrṇaṃ prayacchasi

plain_english: What strong soul outtops you? What stringless soul outpeaks you? So, lord, we sing — bless you? curse you? We cannot say.
sanskrit_cite: ko guṇair adhikas tvattas tvattaḥ ko nirguṇo 'dhikaḥ iti nātha numaḥ kiṃ tvāṃ kiṃ nindāmo na manmahe

plain_english: Though we hymn but the spate of sweet — whose grace fruits in you — to sip it, what stranger is fit? To serve it round — O world-king, who then?
sanskrit_cite: kīrtane 'py amṛtaughasya yatprasatteḥ phalaṃ tava tat pātum api ko 'nyo 'laṃ kim u dātuṃ jagatpate

plain_english: Out of the hoard where every coveted sheaf ripens — from you I beg one thing, lord, in all wise: love of you solely to win.
sanskrit_cite: niḥśeṣaprārthanīyārthasārthasiddhinidhānataḥ tvattas tvadbhaktim evāptuṃ prārthaye nātha sarvathā

plain_english: Hail, triple world's king, hail to you, Becoming — hailed by your court — hail the unbarred might that bestows triple kingship.
sanskrit_cite: namas trailokyanāthāya tubhyaṃ bhava bhavajjuṣām trilokīnāthatādānanirvināyakaśaktaye

plain_english: When men doubt what uproots all ache — master, resolved 'that art thou' — who has failed to flee to you?
sanskrit_cite: niḥśeṣakleśahānasya hetuḥ ka iti saṃśaye svāmin so 'sīti niścitya kas tvāṃ na śaraṇaṃ gataḥ

plain_english: Tasted my fill and shed birth's mirage, I shall win the highest seat — so hope runs here: bright may it blaze for Śambhu's lover.
sanskrit_cite: bhuktvā bhogān bhavabhrāntiṃ hitvā lapsye paraṃ padam ity āśaṃseha śobheta śambhau bhaktimataḥ param

plain_english: Lord, in dreams too, do or utter I foul or fair — proud to hang on you — at home in all places I rest glad.
sanskrit_cite: nātha svapne 'pi yat kuryāṃ brūyāṃ vā sādhv asādhu vā tvadadhīnatvadarpeṇa sarvatrātrāsmi nirvṛtaḥ

plain_english: What lamp of lamps — there, where mind races in your dwelling — mind's lord, could murk touch it? As soon, I deem, as a barren dame's grandson.
sanskrit_cite: jyotiṣām api yaj jyotis tatra tvaddhāmni dhāvataḥ cittasyeśa tamaḥsparśo manye vandhyātmajānujaḥ

plain_english: Methinks one foot already on kind release's road stands he whose hankering runs: 'Śiva I'll honour' — even this.
sanskrit_cite: manye nyastapadaḥ so 'pi kṣemye mokṣasya vartmani manorathaḥ sthito yasya seviṣye śivam ity ayam

plain_english: Through keeping, kindling, killing, in this triple world's errands — yours only, lord, the might — unbound — you watch the weave.
sanskrit_cite: sthityutpattilayair lokatrayasyopakriyāsv iha ekaiveśa bhavacchaktiḥ svatantraṃ tantram īkṣase

plain_english: Saved in these three worlds, unscorched by triple smart — hail him, hail you — you, the dead-quiet mere of sweet.
sanskrit_cite: trilokyām iha kas trātas tritāpyā nopatāpitaḥ tasmai namo 'stu te yas tvaṃ tannirvāṇāmṛtahradaḥ

plain_english: Feigned love of you still ripens true — were it straight, O what crop? Pronounce it, you.
sanskrit_cite: kṛtrimāpi bhavadbhaktir akṛtrimaphalodayā niśchadmā ced bhaved eṣā kiṃphaleti tvayocyatām

plain_english: The eye that sights you, the road that attains you — that yield, Unborn, springs from the gossip-grove grown of you.
sanskrit_cite: tac cakṣur īkṣyase yena sā gatir gamyase yayā phalaṃ tad aja jātaṃ yat tvatkathākalpapādapāt

plain_english: Best past the good, this poise on high in you — to sweep its hindrances, lord, you are my hold.
sanskrit_cite: śreyasā śreya evaitad upari tvayi yā sthitiḥ tadantarāyahṛtaye tvam īśa śaraṇaṃ mama

plain_english: Ah, honeyed past honey, the savour of serving Śarva hoped — in what tick of time does it not turn ever-new?
sanskrit_cite: aho svādutamaḥ śarvasevāśaṃsāsudhārasaḥ kutra kālakalāmātre na yo navanavāyate

plain_english: Ever, unwearied, teeming the triple world with hundredfold fancies — yet single, seamless, lords it — Unborn.
sanskrit_cite: muhur muhur aviśrāntas trailokyaṃ kalpanāśataiḥ kalpayann api ko 'py eko nirvikalpo jayaty ajaḥ

plain_english: By lore's lamp that licks the birth-greased wick of wonts — god, O when shall I stand in your presence, prithee?
sanskrit_cite: malatailāktasaṃsāravāsanāvartidāhinā jñānadīpena deva tvāṃ kadā nu syām upasthitaḥ

plain_english: Grant one blinking's room with faults outworn to lodge within the breast — then, Śambhu, what feat past your doing?
sanskrit_cite: nimeṣam api yady ekaṃ kṣīṇadoṣe kariṣyasi padaṃ citte tadā śambho kiṃ na sampādayiṣyasi

plain_english: 'Blest am I, quits am I, big am I' — firm would that fancy stand, grounded — his whom you ground, lord.
sanskrit_cite: dhanyo 'smi kṛtakṛtyo 'smi mahān asmīti bhāvanā bhavet sālambanā tasya yas tvadālambanaḥ prabho

plain_english: Luck and muck alike you author yourself — yet love of you mothers luck only, solely, lord.
sanskrit_cite: śubhāśubhasya sarvasya svayaṃ kartā bhavān api bhavadbhaktis tu jananī śubhasyaiveśa kevalam

plain_english: Mind pellucid, master — step you in, or at your stepping does it clear? So dangles man.
sanskrit_cite: prasanne manasi svāmin kiṃ tvaṃ niviśase kim u tvatpraveśāt prasīdet tad iti dolāyate janaḥ

plain_english: Nay, here stands sure — your oversight and yours only: mind's favour, master, is fulfilment, the farthest seat.
sanskrit_cite: niścayaḥ punar eṣo 'tra tvadadhiṣṭhānam eva hi prasādo manasaḥ svāmin sā siddhis tat paraṃ padam

plain_english: Word and wit, work and this frame of mine, lord — grace them to gleam with love of you and nought beside.
sanskrit_cite: vacaś cetaś ca kāryaṃ ca śarīraṃ mama yat prabho tvatprasādena tad bhūyād bhavadbhāvaikabhūṣaṇam

plain_english: This praise-gem, heavy with granted longings, Lakṣmī's lodging of love — for Śambhu wrought Bhaṭṭa Nārāyaṇa.
sanskrit_cite: stavacintāmaṇiṃ bhūrimanorathaphalapradam bhaktilakṣmyālayaṃ śambho bhaṭṭanārāyaṇo vyadhāt

plain_english: Through honeyed lips that ravish thought, through seer and the seen — triumphs the lord whose might is bliss displayed — high God.
sanskrit_cite: sugirā cittahāriṇyā paśyantyā dṛśyamānayā jayaty ullāsitānandamahimā parameśvaraḥ
